text:
Start date: 1817-01-19  
Add 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Add 6 days = total 216 days.  
1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but by 100 and not by 400).  
Jan 19 + 216 days:  
Jan has 31 days → days left in Jan after Jan 19: 12 days (Jan 20–31).  
216 − 12 = 204 days left.  
Feb 1817 has 28 days → 204 − 28 = 176.  
Mar 31 → 176 − 31 = 145.  
Apr 30 → 145 − 30 = 115.  
May 31 → 115 − 31 = 84.  
Jun 30 → 84 − 30 = 54.  
Jul 31 → 54 − 31 = 23.  
Aug 23 days → August 23, 1817.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-08-23
